verdict: Local Chrome run: 3 hard failures on the product page (one likely accordion defect, one stale selector, one cart update to confirm) plus one flaky page load; no environment or infra problems (all navigations 200, no console errors).

failures.test: Product extras › opening an accordion item reveals its content
failures.summary: Clicking the "Free Shipping Worldwide" accordion heading does not expand it; its body stays hidden on both attempts.
failures.evidence:
locator resolved to

Every order ships free…

- unexpected value "hidden"; snapshot shows group > heading "Free Shipping Worldwide" with no paragraph, while "Easy Returns & Exchanges" is expanded.
failures.next_step: Manually click the Free Shipping heading on the product page and check the accordion toggles. If it does not, fix the toggle handler. If the trigger is a different element than the h3, point the test at it. The trigger is exposed with no button role, so check that too.

failures.test: Product info › quantity cannot go above the stock of the selected variant
failures.summary: The CSS selector .quantity-stepper__field no longer matches, but the quantity input is present on the page.
failures.evidence: waiting for locator('.quantity-stepper__field'), timeout 15000ms; snapshot has textbox "Quantity": "01".
failures.next_step: Change the locator to page.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Quantity" }). Also check the expected value, since the field renders zero-padded ("01"), so 12 may show as "12" but low values differ.

failures.test: Product info › Add to Cart updates the header basket badge
failures.summary: After Charcoal and quantity 2 were selected, the basket never updated and the header badge never appeared.
failures.evidence: waiting for locator('.site-header__badge') to be visible; snapshot shows radio "Charcoal" [checked] and textbox "Quantity": "02", but the header still reads button "Basket, 0 items" and the CTA still reads button "Add to Cart" (not "Added").
failures.next_step: Check that productPage.addToCart actually clicks Add to Cart before waiting on .site-header__badge. If it does, reproduce Add to Cart manually. If it does not, or the badge class was renamed, reclassify as test_bug and wait on the "Basket, 2 items" button instead.

failures.test: Delivery estimate › the delivery date range is calculated from the visitor's date after load
failures.summary: page.goto timed out waiting for the load event once, then the test passed on retry.
failures.evidence: TimeoutError: page.goto: Timeout 30000ms exceeded, waiting until "load"; outcome flaky; snapshot shows definition "Oct 08-12" and status 200.
failures.next_step: Find which resource delays the load event on the local server, or switch gotoProduct to waitUntil "domcontentloaded". Watch whether page.clock.setFixedTime correlates with slow loads.
